items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Jay McCobbs his name was. White guy. ... My mother's mother died when she was born. ... her grandmother was working for this year, Jay McCobbs. And she the one that was taking care of my mother when she was a little kid coming up.

ctx.x: She was pretty good to work with her?

Oh yeah, she was good to work with her. She was good to work with her. In fact, every one of them that I ever played with her on the vaudeville, she was, you know, good to work with her. Now this white fella that owned this theater, he probably raised my mother. Jay McCobbs his name was. White guy.
